resolution_notes: free_tier_limits: original CONFIRMED. Official RAWG API docs (https://rawg.io/apidocs) state free plan is 20,000 requests per month; paid Business plans for higher quotas. Verifier A’s rewrite was cosmetic (same figure). Verifier B’s “unofficial” caution is overstated—the quota is documented on the official apidocs page. Automated HTTP 522 on api.rawg.io is treated as transient CDN/origin failure, not evidence the free-tier figure is wrong; status left operational pending clearer outage signal.
